customer_name: City and County of San Francisco
business_problem: centralize data across departments so city teams could share information securely, support streaming airport operations data, and coordinate new public-service programs faster.
solution_summary: City and County of San Francisco uses Snowflake, Snowpipe Streaming, and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to centralize data across departments so city teams could share information securely, support streaming airport operations data, and coordinate new public-service programs faster. Data from multiple city departments, airport transportation systems, and cross-department programs are centralized in Snowflake to support public-service coordination. Snowpipe Streaming handles lower-latency transportation feeds while the broader platform supports governed sharing and centralized refresh across previously isolated departmental datasets. Department staff, airport operations teams, and program managers consume the shared data through dashboards and operational tools that support investigations, permit compliance, and new public-service programs. solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data platform that stores governed datasets and serves analytics or AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Snowpipe Streaming
solution_components.role: Loads low-latency event data directly into Snowflake.

solution_components.name: Secure Data Sharing
solution_components.role: Shares governed data with partners or internal consumers without moving copies.

data_flow: departmental, transportation, and city-program data flow into Snowflake, Snowpipe Streaming, and Secure Data Sharing; curated data, reports, and model outputs are then served to city departments, airport operations staff, and program managers.
business_outcome: San Francisco engaged 16 departments in one year, runs data refresh operations 50% faster while handling 18x more data, and improved Tableau refresh speed by 300x for some airport use cases.
